[LLSU.5.1] Temporal predicates in LHS patterns. Timer-based RHS
continuations (`after <dur>:` and `after <dur> as <expr>:`)
are normative in v1 per [LTAC]
and [LRST], which itemise them.

| Name | Explanation | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|
| `within_predicate` | `within <dur>` on a pattern — fact entered in the last N | compare `t.dwell` against N |
| `not_within_predicate` | `not <pattern> within <dur>` — no matching fact entered in last N | not generally avoidable for absence-based rules |
| `dwell_alias` | `t.dwell` compile-time alias for the time since the fact entered working memory | none: the entry stamp has no other author syntax ([LEXP.9.5.2]) |
